_about: One page per region the app serves (BusBus/Transit/SupportedRegions.swift), built by i18n/regions.py at bus-times/<slug>/ (English) and bus-times/<slug>/<lang>/. order = the landing page's 'Where it runs' list, top to bottom. fit: full = live positions and times, arrivals = times only. web = the web app covers it (web/js/transit/regions.js). English texts under text.en; other languages' texts live in regions/<lang>.json under "regions".

en.lede: The bus you take every day on one board, with live predictions counting down to the next bus and the one after it.
en.coverage: Buses across New South Wales: Sydney, the Hunter, the Illawarra and the regional towns, with Transport for NSW's live predictions.

en.name: Wellington
en.title: Live Wellington Bus Times – Metlink Arrivals & Tracker | My Bus Stop
en.description: Live arrival times for Metlink buses in Wellington, and where each bus is on its route right now. Free on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Apple TV.
en.lede: The Metlink bus you take every day on one board: the minutes until it reaches your stop, and where it is on its route right now.
en.coverage: Metlink buses across the Greater Wellington region: the city, the Hutt Valley, Porirua, the Kāpiti Coast and the Wairarapa.
